target: Prior definition retained: author/inferred TAM with raw PGAM5 count >0; count=0 is RNA nondetection, not protein-negative subtype
discovery: GSE151530 HCC tumors only, all available author cell types
external: GSE149614 primary T-ending tumors, prior inferred macrophage labels; external expression and performance never used to select features/configuration
feature_selection: All shared symbols; merge duplicated gene symbols by summing raw counts. Exclude MT-/RPL/RPS genes from deconvolution feature selection only; previous DE tables unchanged. Select informative class contrasts solely from training donors
competitors: Coarse author labels plus fixed descriptive cycling splits (2/6 detected); low-count cycling groups fall back to parent. Unknown retained; external Other_myeloid treated as an unrepresented challenge, not relabelled as known DC
internal_validation: Nested donor-held-out: select configuration using inner training-donor tests, refit without outer donor, then evaluate independent outer-donor sampled mixtures. Fixed fold/configuration choices; no feature discovery on outer/external expressions
mixtures: 2000 cells sampled within donor with replacement. Target fractions 0,0.5,1,2,5%, constant total TAM25%; diverse competing cell proportions; explicit zero-target cycling and unrepresented-myeloid challenges. Equal-RNA CP10K averages and pooled-count RNA-weighted mixtures tested. Cell library size is NOT validated biological RNA content
algorithm: Local linear nonnegative least squares (NNLS), all model components fitted simultaneously; per-gene training-only scaling. No CIBERSORTx/MuSiC/BayesPrism service or executable invoked
TCGA_gate: Do not generate or interpret TCGA-LIHC abundance using a reference that fails validation. Even a numerical pass requires platform-compatible bulk/reference units and proper abundance denominator before TCGA application
sensitivity: Final locked configuration evaluated with and without defining PGAM5 gene and with versus without cycling competitors; sensitivity results do not re-tune main configuration
